features.quote: The model can end the loop by calling `finish`
features.justification_quote: one measured behavior is "giving up." We want the model's own decision to disengage to be a first-class, logged event

features.quote: the loop also caps at `max_turns` and a wall-clock limit
features.justification_quote: forcing it to keep emitting until a turn cap — which would distort the giving-up signal and waste tokens
